extName.description: Name of the extension in the store and the toolbar

extDescription.message: Shorten the page you are on to your own flatlink server – one click in the toolbar, no third-party service.

htmlLang.description: Wert für <html lang> – die Sprache DIESER Datei, nicht die des Browsers

setupIntroA.message: The quickest way is a pairing code: on your flatlink server, under

setupIntroB.message: generate one and paste it here – it holds both the address and the API key.

qrAlt.message: QR code for the short link

errKeyInvalid.message: The API key is no longer valid.

errNoPermission.message: This account does not have permission for that.

errTooMany.message: Too many requests – please wait a moment.

errNoLink.message: The response contained no short link.

errUnreachable.message: The server cannot be reached. Check the address in the settings – and grant permission there.

pairingHintA.message: You generate the code on your flatlink server, under

pairingHintB.message: It holds the address and the API key – copy it once, paste it here, done.

tokenHintA.message: You create one on your flatlink server:

tokenHintB.message: It is shown only once. It is kept in this browser's local storage – not in browser sync, so it never travels through anyone else's data centre.

errBothNeeded.message: Both the address and the API key are needed.

errNoHostAccess.message: Without access to this address the extension cannot talk to your flatlink server.

errKeyWrong.message: The API key is not valid. Is it correct, and does it belong to this server?

errNoApi.message: No flatlink API answers at this address. What is meant is the server's home page – without /admin and without a path after it.

errStatusAddress.message: The server responded with $code$. Is the address right?

errUnreachableShort.message: The server cannot be reached at this address.

accessRemoved.message: Access removed. The key itself stays valid on your flatlink server – revoke it there if it should be gone.

errNotPairingCode.message: That does not look like a pairing code – those begin with “flc_”.

errCodeIncomplete.message: The code is incomplete. Perhaps it was not copied in full?

errCodeUnreadable.message: The code cannot be read. Perhaps it was not copied in full?
